title: Dynamic Loop Fusion in High-Level Synthesis.

evidence.quote: Our implementation and evaluation are publicly available [59].
[59] Robert Szafarczyk. 2024. Dynamic Loop Fusion in HLS - FPGA25 artifact. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14383450

Code implementing the ideas from the paper "Dynamic Loop Fusion in High-Level Synthesis", together with the evaluation. This repo consists of: Data Unit template in lsq/DataUntiDRAM.hpp... Address monotonicity analysis... in lib/DynamicLoopFusionAnalysis.cpp... The transformation that inserts our DU and generates loop PEs and AGUs is in lib/DynamicLoopFusionTransform.cpp. Evaluation scripts, benchmarks, and results are in the directory experiments/.
Commit 47ecacb7 by Robert Szafarczyk on 2024-09-27: 'Add hazard pair prunning. Use DUInfo name.'
Commit b7f49fe4 by Robert Szafarczyk on 2024-09-27: 'Add tanh+spmv bench.'
Commit 3c59ad13 by Robert Szafarczyk on 2024-09-10: 'Add "l" definition in hazard check.'
Commit 6dfbacff by Robert Szafarczyk on 2024-09-17: 'Add speculation support to dynamic loop fusion.'
Commit 3f9e0c14 by Robert Szafarczyk on 2024-08-26: 'Add fusion benchmarks and supporting files.'

The dynamic-fusion branch contains files: lib/DynamicLoopFusionAnalysis.cpp, lib/DynamicLoopFusionTransform.cpp, lsq/DataUnitDRAM.hpp, and experiments/ with benchmark files (raw_loop, war_loop, waw_loop, bnn_dram, page_rank_dram, fft2x_dram, matrix_power_dram, hist2x_dram, tanh_spmv_dram) which match the paper's benchmarks (RAWloop, WARloop, WAWloop, bnn, pagerank, fft, matpower, hist+add, tanh+spmv).
Repository owner 'robertszafa' is the first author Robert Szafarczyk (University of Glasgow).
Commits on the dynamic-fusion branch date from Aug 2024 to Oct 2024, matching the artifact date (2024) and predating the FPGA 2025 conference.

repos.notes: The repo robertszafa/elastic-sycl-hls is the authors' codebase. The FPGA25 paper's code is in the 'dynamic-fusion' branch. The HLS scan returned 'repo_no_hls' because Intel SYCL HLS uses C++ attributes (e.g., [[intel::fpga_register]]) rather than #pragma HLS or other dialects that the scanner detects. The code is clearly HLS: the DataUnitDRAM.hpp implements the Data Unit (DU) for dynamic memory disambiguation, and the LLVM passes in lib/ are compiler passes for the Intel SYCL HLS toolchain.

summary: Found the authors' code repository (robertszafa/elastic-sycl-hls, dynamic-fusion branch) containing the FPGA25 artifact. The paper cites a Zenodo DOI (10.5281/zenodo.14383450) for code availability; the Zenodo artifact description matches files in the dynamic-fusion branch exactly (DynamicLoopFusionAnalysis.cpp, DynamicLoopFusionTransform.cpp, DataUnitDRAM.hpp, and matching benchmark files). Commits by first author Robert Szafarczyk from Aug-Oct 2024 add dynamic loop fusion support. The HLS scanner returned 'repo_no_hls' because it does not detect Intel SYCL HLS patterns (the code uses Intel's SYCL HLS compiler, not Vitis/Catapult dialects). I am highly confident this is the correct repo for the paper.
